_comment: Template for a UXR study spec. Copy this file to the study folder root.
Replace the placeholder text below, then run:
research_questions become RQ1, RQ2, and so on, in list order.
hypotheses take 'H1: text' strings, or {"label": "H1", "text": "..."} objects.
analysis_questions become A1, A2, and so on, in list order.
An optional 'ticket' key overrides the name from the file name.
research_questions: Why do participants stop during first-run setup?
hypotheses: H1: Participants stop when the setup wording names no outcome.
analysis_questions: Which moments show the strongest friction?
